Method of Attack: Local privilege escalation via DLL search-order hijacking
Loading unsigned DLLs to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges
Impacted Systems: Most HP Windows laptops and desktops with HP Touchpoint Analytics installed
Attack Vector: DLL search-order hijacking exploiting uncontrolled DLL search path and unsigned DLL loading
Exploitation of Open Hardware Monitor library used by HP Touchpoint Analytics
Writing unsigned DLLs to writable directories in Windows PATH (e.g., C:/python27) to be loaded by the service
Indicators of Compromise: Unsigned DLLs named atiadlxx.dll, atiadlxy.dll, Nvapi64.dll loaded from writable folders
HP Touchpoint Analytics Client versions prior to 4.1.4.2827
